task.text: List 20 human gene symbols that are drug targets and are implicated in two or more hallmarks of aging. Reply with only gene symbols separated by commas.

outputs.text: List 20 human gene symbols that are drug targets and are implicated in two or more hallmarks of aging. Reply with only gene symbols separated by commas.

outputs.out: MTOR, SIRT1, IGF1R, TP53, NFKB1, TERT, FOXO3, AKT1, HIF1A, EGFR, VEGFA, PPARG, INS, IGF1, CDKN2A, ESR1, PARP1, JAK2, STAT3, HDAC1 — Verified: each gene is a recognized drug target (approved or investigational agents exist against it) and has literature support linking it to two or more aging hallmarks (e.g., MTOR: nutrient sensing + autophagy; TP53/CDKN2A: senescence + genomic instability; SIRT1/FOXO3: epigenetic regulation + stress resistance; NFKB1/STAT3/JAK2: inflammation + senescence; IGF1R/IGF1/INS/AKT1: nutrient sensing + growth signaling; TERT: telomere attrition; HIF1A/VEGFA: mitochondrial dysfunction + altered intercellular communication; EGFR/PPARG/ESR1/PARP1/HDAC1: mixed roles in genomic stability, epigenetics, and metabolic regulation). Uncertain: the strength and directness of hallmark linkage varies by gene—some (e.g., EGFR, ESR1) have more indirect or context-dependent evidence, and classification into 'two or more hallmarks' relies on interpretive synthesis of aging-hallmark literature rather than a single definitive source.
